heading: About
paragraphs: I'm Kat. I’m what happens when the arty kid grows up through the dawn of the internet.
I've been working in design for nearly twenty years, starting out in visual communication before finding my way through digital design, advertising and eventually into product and technology.

I like pulling apart complicated ideas and figuring out how the pieces fit together. Getting stuck into a messy problem or a stack of research is where I get my kicks. I care deeply about equality and the responsibilities that come with designing technology. I have strong convictions, but I'm equally interested in understanding perspectives that challenge my own.
